contract: Read each complete AVC/AAC HLS segment and all five progressive TS188 inputs through a TS PES feed. Drive each standalone AVC and AAC assembler through push_compact and drain both at EOF.

The reference reads the same forward windows with the TS demuxer and the stock AVC and AAC parsers. Fold all units in per-lane order, video first, including the AVC source Annex B bytes, PES times, IDR and raster, and AAC frame bytes with exact duration.

Each operation constructs the feed and assemblers, processes and releases the complete input, retains units through drain and folds them. Input loading is outside the operation. Refusal is a single kind 8 record.

open_deviations.reading: An exact repeat of a payload-bearing transport packet
open_deviations.clause: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) section 2.4.3.3 permits two consecutive same-PID packets with the same continuity counter and adaptation_field_control 01 or 11 when their bytes match apart from a valid PCR.
open_deviations.candidate: Returns 36 compact-input AAC and AVC access-unit records with 5573 source bytes, matching the nonduplicated control.
open_deviations.reference: Reports a PES size mismatch, marks the AAC packet corrupt and yields a single refusal record.
open_deviations.compat: compat::pes::reject_corrupt_duplicate_carrier for a consumer reproducing the reference demux corruption decision.

open_deviations.reading: A transport AVC access unit opens with SEI instead of an access-unit delimiter
open_deviations.clause: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) section 2.14.1 requires an AUD in every carried AVC access unit. H.264 (08/2024) section 7.4.1.2.3 puts it first.
open_deviations.candidate: Returns Unsupported with AVC TS access unit has no initial delimiter before publishing a unit.
open_deviations.reference: Accepts the first 3640-byte unit starting with SEI at PTS 133500 and DTS 126000 and continues to the end.
open_deviations.compat: compat::avc::recover_missing_delimiter for a consumer accepting delimiterless transport AVC.
